title: Serino 2011 · weak and strong tactile targets
citation: Serino, A., Canzoneri, E., & Avenanti, A. (2011). Fronto-parietal areas necessary for a multisensory representation of peripersonal space in humans: an rTMS study. Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience, 23(10), 2956–2967.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.sound: 100 ms white noise from matched fixed loudspeakers at approximately 70 dB at the head vertex.
published_method.touch: 100 µs single electrical pulses at the dorsal right index finger. Participant-specific weak and strong targets use separate electrode pairs.

timing.anchor: Programmed onset; the nominal 5 ms far-sound lead compensates for longer acoustic propagation.

published_method.response: Say “tah” as fast as possible for the instructed tactile intensity. Withhold that response to the other intensity and sound alone.

source_provenance.value: White noise played over two identical physical loudspeakers. Spectral output checked for consistency.
source_provenance.gap: Source waveform, speaker model, sample rate and noise-generation recipe remain unknown.

gain_envelope.gap: Rise/fall, waveform scaling and SPL weighting remain unknown.

renderer_or_apparatus.source: Article pp. 2957–2958, Experiment 1A Materials; p. 2959, Procedure
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Speaker model, audio interface, event timing accuracy and relay threshold remain unknown.

condition_intermixing.value: Weak and strong tactile trials crossed with sound conditions, plus auditory-only catches.
condition_intermixing.gap: Within-block sequence, mixing algorithm and seed remain unknown.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: The per-block allocation for each reported trial family remains unclear.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: Exact intertrial delay and jitter policy remain unknown.

response_window.source: Article p. 2959, Procedure and Data analysis
response_window.gap: The paper specifies offline RT trimming and approximate trial duration. Online response cutoff and voice-key detection threshold remain unknown.

task_sequence_rules.value: Give a speeded vocal response to the block's target intensity only. Withhold response to the other tactile intensity and to sound-only catches. Ignore the sound.

value.electrodes: Two Neuroline pairs, one per intensity

tactile_stimulus.source: Article pp. 2957–2959, Experiment 1A Materials and Procedure
tactile_stimulus.gap: The article describes constant-current equipment and calls the waveform constant voltage. Per-participant parameters and hardware equivalence remain open.

value.far_note: Far sound triggered 5 ms before the tactile pulse to compensate for propagation delay.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only no-sound trials of both intensities.

baseline_timing.gap: No auditory onset on tactile-only trials.

catch_trial_type.value: Near or far sound without tactile stimulus. No response required.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Reported pool allocation is clear. Its split between target-instruction blocks is unclear.

total_trial_count.gap: The article calls this a total and then describes two blocks without specifying the per-block allocation.

implementation_gaps: The physical near/far speaker channels and electrical pulse controller need a shared clock, with calibrated level, pulse delivery and physical onset verification.
A measured voice key must score the currently instructed intensity as Go and the other intensity and sound-only trials as No-Go. A manual button or vibration marker is insufficient.
The original noise waveform, realized sequence, voice-key threshold and response deadline are unavailable.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
